completion_rule: Every inherited search component and every SDST extension component must be reachable and behaviorally connected before the adapted method claim can pass semantic review.
variant_rule: All construction, decoding, timing, neighborhood, acceptance, and output paths must preserve the sequence-dependent setup semantics declared by the active requirement and IO documents.

required_components.title: Requirement-derived setup semantics and complete setup-aware decoder
required_behaviors: Read setup data and initial-setup conventions from the active IO contract without importing backend parser or evaluator code.
Compute each machine start from its immediate machine predecessor's completion plus the directed sequence-dependent setup time while also respecting job precedence.

Reject incomplete, cyclic, duplicate, ineligible, or setup-inconsistent schedules and emit processing intervals according to the active output contract rather than silently folding setup into processing duration.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable standalone parser and decoder paths plus behavioral tests for asymmetric setup, changed predecessor, and first-on-machine semantics.

required_components.title: Setup-aware sequence and reassignment candidate evaluation
required_behaviors: For every same-machine order move, account for all setup arcs removed and introduced around the changed sequence before acceptance.
For every alternative-machine move, remove the old setup links, insert with eligible target-machine predecessor/successor context, and use setup-aware bounded insertion positions.
Accept or rank final candidates only from a complete setup-aware decode under the active constraints; setup delta may filter or order candidates but cannot replace decoded objective comparison.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable same-machine and reassignment move paths that consume directed setup values and then invoke the complete decoder.

required_components.title: Setup-aware critical timing and adaptive search pressure
required_behaviors: Include active setup arcs in forward/backward timing and critical-machine tightness checks.
Recompute critical structure after accepted sequence or machine changes instead of reusing setup-obsolete timing.
When setup-derived features influence adaptive scoring or diversification, update and consume them in reachable move decisions without replacing the decoded objective.
required_components.evidence_required: Reachable critical timing refresh and adaptive scoring paths with tests where predecessor-dependent setup changes criticality or ranking.

coupled_groups.rule: The exact setup-aware move that is generated and scored must be fully decoded with its new directed setup arcs before it can be accepted or committed.
Criticality, adaptive pressure, and diversification must consume timing that reflects the current setup-aware machine sequences while preserving the global best.
